examples: 'kva gatimAnuzARAM ca Danuzo'sya prapUraRe' (rA॰1.67.20). prasajya Danuza AkarRakarzaRa ityarTaH.
'ratnErDanESca paSuBiH sasyEScApi pfTagviDEH. nagaraM vizayaScAsya pratipUrRastadA'Bavat' (BA0 anu0 2.15).. pratiranarTakaH pUrRa ityevArTaH.

'na talloke dravyamasti yallokaM pratipUrayet. samudrakalpaH puruzo na kadAcana pUryate' (BA0 anu0 93.46).. pUrvavAkye pratiSabdaH SrUyate, uttarasmiMSca tadaBAvaH. samAnaScArTaH. tena pratiSabdo'narTakaH.
'sarvamalajjAkaramiha yadyat kurvanti paripUrRAH' (paYcata0 5.10). paripUrRA atyantaM samarTAH.
